verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own isolated places to experiment. Free Edition is a separate no-cost workspace "designed for... experimenting with data and AI", which can be used with sample data. The AI Playground lets users interactively test and prototype tool-calling agents. However, nothing documents a sandbox that mirrors production for testing against, so this is only partial; time travel and Unity Catalog access controls are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented dev/staging environment or workspace separation from production, data cloning or branching for safe test copies, agent-specific sandboxed execution against non-production data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
